import { AuiProvider, Derived, useAui } from "@assistant-ui/store";
import { useMemo } from "@assistant-ui/tap/react-shim";
import { jsx } from "react/jsx-runtime";
//#region src/react/providers/PartByIndexProvider.tsx
const PartByIndexProvider = ({ index, children }) => {
	const lastPartRef = useMemo(() => ({
		index,
		current: null
	}), [index]);
	return /* @__PURE__ */ jsx(AuiProvider, {
		value: useAui({ part: Derived({
			source: "message",
			query: {
				type: "index",
				index
			},
			get: (aui) => {
				const message = aui.message();
				if (index >= message.getState().parts.length && lastPartRef.current) return lastPartRef.current;
				const part = message.part({ index });
				lastPartRef.current = part;
				return part;
			}
		}) }),
		children
	});
};
//#endregion
export { PartByIndexProvider };
